_doc: a-faire mod (À faire par Julian) settings. Override any key in ~/.claude/a-faire/config.json (deep merge; keys starting with _ are ignored). Every source can be turned off with enabled: false; a missing file is skipped silently. Paths accept ~.
_login_match: A line or alert matching this goes to « Connexions / 2FA ».
login_match: \b(login|log in|sign[- ]?in|connexion|se connecter|2FA|MFA|OTP|tenant|Cloudflare Access|accès cloud|cloud access|mot de passe|password|identifiants?|credentials?)\b
_open: Categories unfolded when the pane opens: nonempty (every category with something to do), all, none, or a list of ids.

questions._match: Only lines matching this wait for Julian (the rest are choices agents already made).

decisions._files: Markdown backlogs of pending decisions: open table rows « | n | decision | facts | R | » and « ⚠ **Your action:** » lines; parsing stops at a heading matching stop. Set your own in ~/.claude/a-faire/config.json.

prs._doc: Your open PRs (gh search prs --author @me) that carry one of labels, or one sentence of the title or body naming Julian (name) and a verb (verbs). Cached ttl_min minutes; tokens stay with gh.
prs.name: \bJulian\b

mods._roots: Folders holding mod folders (each with .claude-plugin/plugin.json). Empty: the folder this mod sits in.

veille_feed._doc: The veille watcher pushes new items of these priorities once each (Windows notification, and the e-mail digest when smtp.json works).
